summary: T7-03, round 8, reviewer claude (claude-sonnet-5-5). I reviewed commits ceeae12..9864e94. All five story checks exit 0. The layout, banners, header, footer and home page match the acceptance criteria as far as I could verify them. The diff touches only paths in the story's scope. The one thing I did not reproduce is the gzip -9 initial-JS measurement. The author reports 177,190 B in the story notes. The review permissions forbid the loop it needs.

checks.evidence: ruff, mypy, eslint and tsc all passed. Turbo showed 4 successful tasks, all cache hits.
pytest 404 passed. Web vitest 325 passed (mode-banner 14, page-check 105, site-layout 33). Schema vitest 157 passed. Turbo showed these as cache hits.
/ is static (○) and /_not-found is static (○). Build compiled successfully.
Output: 'web-smoke: GET http://127.0.0.1:55341/ (prerendered) shows the mock banner, "Shipping mode: not chosen (G0 NOT_RUN)" and bundle version mock-0 in the footer'.

checks.criterion: AC1 mode banner and mock banner text
checks.evidence: mode-banner.tsx:10-21 holds the PRD 4 titles. The mode-banner tests pass, including a comparison with PRD.md. mock-banner.tsx:8-15 renders the banner only when the text is non-null, with role="status".

checks.criterion: AC2 layout renders skip link, mock banner, mode banner, nav, main and footer
checks.evidence: layout.tsx:28-39. The footer reads 'Bundle version: <v> · Schema <v>' (site-footer.tsx:9), which follows the recorded orchestrator decision and T0-05 smoke wording. This is a literal-reading difference only.
site-header.tsx:11-19 lists the seven links. They are plain next/link anchors, and no /api/docs, /paper, /probe or /compare link exists.

checks.criterion: AC4 keyboard order, focus ring, aria-current
checks.evidence: site-header.tsx:27-36 puts aria-current="page" on the link whose href equals the pathname, in DOM order. Tests in site-layout.test.tsx pass. I did not inspect the global focus-ring CSS myself.
page.tsx:13-14 holds the title and one factual line with no numbers, targets or claims. Banner texts come from PRD 4 verbatim.
page.tsx:8 sets dynamic = 'error'. The build shows / as static. make web-smoke passes.

checks.criterion: AC7 page-check updated test-first, nothing weakened
checks.evidence: page-check.test.ts has 105 passing tests, and the site-layout test runs pageProblems against the real RootLayout. The earlier round fixes (exact banner, footer and mode texts, a single footer, stray-text accounting, a parse5 document tree, head and title exclusion) are all in place. I did not re-read page-check.ts line by line; I relied on the test suite and the author's evidence for the earlier rounds.

checks.criterion: AC8 only client component is site-header.tsx; initial JS within 250 kB
checks.evidence: The client-component part holds: site-header.tsx is the only 'use client' file among the layout files I read, and / is static. The gzip -9 sum needs a shell loop, which the review permissions forbid. The author reports 177,190 B (+3,216 B over the 173,974 B baseline), which is within 250 kB. I did not reproduce it.

checks.command: git diff --name-only ceeae12..9864e94 -- apps pnpm-lock.yaml config
checks.evidence: All 15 paths are in the story's files list, or are tests/markup.ts and tests/prd.ts under the apps/web/tests/* pattern. config/run.yaml was not touched.

findings.claim: I did not reproduce the initial-JS gzip -9 figure of 177,190 B.
findings.evidence: The measurement needs a loop or pipe, which the review permissions forbid. The build shows / as static and site-header.tsx is the only client module I found. The author's figure is within the 250 kB budget.

resolution.reason: Reproduced after make web-build at a389efd: the six <script src> files of apps/web/.next/server/app/index.html at gzip -9 are 48,186 + 71,595 + 3,936 + 6,629 + 39,390 + 7,454 = 177,190 B, which is +3,216 B over the T0 baseline of 173,974 B and within the PRD 8.10 budget of 250 kB, the same figure as in the story notes. The client reference manifest for /page has 9 modules, and the only one outside node_modules is apps/web/components/site-header.tsx. Command: grep -o "<script src=..." index.html | sort -u | while read -r f; do gzip -9 -c .next/$f | wc -c; done | awk sum. No code change is needed.
